source_structure: One English knee report with compartment headings and numbered conclusion repeating the major findings. No explicit knee side, bilateral phrase, second technique/report block or previous examination. Medial/lateral describe anatomical locations within the knee.
order: Full original sources independently read and frozen before neutral images; every displayed sample personally viewed before other assessor visual conclusions for this package; second-six metadata triage had already been read after the separate root source freeze. Case identities and existing metadata triage were disclosed. This package displays only authorized selected series; no full-study pixel coverage is implied.

observations.selection_scope: All four main study series sampled; three views per series, not every source slice.
observations.anatomical_scope: All 12 selected images show knee anatomy. Axial 3, coronal 4 and sagittal 5/6 are compatible with one gross main knee protocol. No displayed second opposing knee set is apparent.

observations.laterality_limit: All captions literally show B and descriptions have RT prefixes. Sparse displayed anatomy does not establish a named side, explain the B tag or prove every slice is unilateral. A single unsided report is not converted to bilateral by the header alone.
observations.disposition: No disease labels, tag changes or automatic exclusion inferred from these sparse images.
